verdict.rationale: First-party docs show `$skill-installer` installing individual curated skills by name (e.g. `linear`, `gh-address-comments`) or by GitHub directory URL from the openai/skills collection. A hands-on probe confirmed that `npx skills add openai/plugins --skill plugin-creator` pulled just that one skill out of the plugins repo. Missing for 10: no evidence that the native `/plugins` browser can install a subset of a plugin's bundled skills, since plugins appear to install as whole bundles there.
